cards.title: There is no user login here
items: this repo teaches an extension, not an account system: the trust boundary is the message sender, the permission table and the token in chrome.storage.session
the extension has no authentication server of its own; if the product has one, the worker talks to it through the SDK and the token lands in storage.session
the page never receives a token — not through a message, not through window.postMessage, not in the DOM

cards.title: The gate stack, in order
items: sender.id must equal chrome.runtime.id; another extension is null unless explicitly allowlisted
then the origin: chrome-extension://<id>/… is a UI surface, a sender.tab with a URL on the content allowlist is a content script
then the frame, then the message permission table — a type absent from the table is rejected — then the payload schema

cards.title: The content subset is deliberately small
items: a content script may capture a user action and send a typed command; a session, policy or settings type is never in its subset
the worker re-validates the sender even when the content script already did: the page is untrusted data
onMessageExternal is limited to allowlisted origins in externally_connectable, never a wildcard

cards.title: Errors are values
items: a rejected message answers a typed FORBIDDEN, never a silent undefined — the RPC client surfaces a typed error
the envelope carries a protocol version, a correlation id and a request id; both ends parse it with the same schema
an unknown version or an unknown payload field is rejected rather than accepted and ignored
